title: 메신저 앱 메뉴 읽기: 채팅, 검색, 알림은 어디예요?
objective: By the end, you can read the main menu words in a Korean messenger app (like 채팅, 검색, 알림, 삭제) and find the right button for a simple task, such as sending a message or adding a friend.
summary: Learners read the menus and buttons of a typical Korean messenger app so they can find what they need.
note: The screens on this sheet are made-up examples. Real messenger apps may use slightly different words.

task.title: Read the app screen
task.line: Use the menu words and tips on page 1 to answer each question.

sections.heading: The screen: what you see in the app
paragraphs: [화면 아래 메뉴]   친구  |  채팅 (3)  |  알림  |  설정
[채팅방: 민수]   민수: 내일 몇 시에 만나요?  /  나: 2시 어때요? 1  /  [+]  [메시지 입력]  [보내기]

items.text: This tab shows the list of your friends.
This tab shows all your conversations.
Use it to add a new person to your list.
Type a name or a word to find it.
Lets you pick a photo from your phone.
Turns message sounds and pop-ups on or off.
Removes a message or a chat.
Press it to finish or say yes.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: A number on a tab, like 채팅 (3), means 3 new messages you have not read. In many Korean messenger apps, a small 1 next to your message means your friend has not read it yet. When the 1 goes away, they read it.
켜짐 = on, 꺼짐 = off. 확인 = OK, 취소 = cancel.

exercises: Read the menu and answer in Korean: [화면 아래 메뉴] 친구 | 채팅 (5) | 알림 | 설정 ① Which tab has new messages? ② How many new messages are there?
Choose the right menu: ① 지수 씨 이름을 찾고 싶어요. (삭제 / 검색) ② 밤에 소리를 끄고 싶어요. (알림 / 사진) ③ 옛날 메시지를 지우고 싶어요. (보내기 / 삭제)
Put the steps in order to add a new friend: 확인 / 친구 / 전화번호 / 친구 추가
Fill in the blank with a menu word: 친구에게 "생일 축하해요!"를 썼어요. 이제 ____를 누르세요.
Read the chat and write Yes or No: [채팅방: 지수] 지수: 오늘 저녁 같이 먹어요! / 나: 좋아요. 7시 어때요? 1 ① 지수 씨는 내 메시지를 읽었어요. ② 내가 7시를 말했어요.
answers: ① 검색 ② 알림 ③ 삭제
